# OpenDevUtils

> OpenDevUtils is a privacy-first collection of developer utilities available as a web app, desktop app, and Chrome extension. Tools run locally in the browser or app; do not submit production secrets, private keys, tokens, or certificates to any online tool unless you understand its handling.

Use the homepage to discover the full collection. Each utility URL opens an interactive, client-side tool. The site does not currently publish Markdown mirrors of these pages.

## Core tools

- [OpenDevUtils home](https://www.opendevutils.com/): Browse all utilities, desktop downloads, Chrome extension information, and the webhook inspector.
- [JSON Toolbox](https://www.opendevutils.com/json): Format, validate, diff, query, convert, and generate schemas for JSON.
- [Base64 Converter](https://www.opendevutils.com/base64): Encode and decode Base64 strings.
- [URL Encoder/Decoder](https://www.opendevutils.com/url): Encode and decode URL strings.
- [cURL to Code](https://www.opendevutils.com/curl): Convert cURL commands into application code.
- [YAML Validator](https://www.opendevutils.com/yaml): Validate and convert YAML.
- [SQL Formatter](https://www.opendevutils.com/sql): Format PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, and PL/SQL queries.
- [Markdown Preview](https://www.opendevutils.com/markdown): Preview Markdown as rendered HTML.

## Conversion and formatting

- [Colour Converter](https://www.opendevutils.com/color): Convert between colour formats.
- [Number Base Converter](https://www.opendevutils.com/numberbase): Convert binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal values.
- [Zlib Compressor/Decompressor](https://www.opendevutils.com/zlib): Compress and decompress zlib data with Base64 support.
- [Cron Parser](https://www.opendevutils.com/cron): Parse and explain cron expressions.
- [RegExp Tester](https://www.opendevutils.com/regex): Test and debug regular expressions.
- [Timestamp/Date Converter](https://www.opendevutils.com/timestamp): Convert Unix timestamps, compare dates, and inspect date values.
- [String Analyser](https://www.opendevutils.com/string): Analyse text statistics and transform letter case.
- [Text Diff](https://www.opendevutils.com/diff): Compare two text inputs and identify differences.

## Security and generators

- [JWT Decoder/Encoder](https://www.opendevutils.com/jwt): Decode, encode, and validate JWT tokens.
- [Hash Generator](https://www.opendevutils.com/hash): Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, and bcrypt hashes.
- [Key Pair Generator](https://www.opendevutils.com/keypair): Generate RSA, Ed25519, and ECDSA key pairs for SSL and SSH.
- [UUID Generator/Decoder](https://www.opendevutils.com/uuid): Generate, validate, and decode UUID versions 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7.
- [SSL Certificate Decoder](https://www.opendevutils.com/ssl): Decode and inspect X.509 certificates.

## Reference

- [HTTP Status Code Reference](https://www.opendevutils.com/httpstatus): Look up HTTP response status codes and meanings.
- [MIME Type Lookup](https://www.opendevutils.com/mimetype): Convert between file extensions and MIME types.

## Optional

- [Privacy policy](https://www.opendevutils.com/privacy): Privacy information for the web app.
- [Source code](https://github.com/gammabowl/opendevutils): OpenDevUtils source repository, contribution guidance, and release history.
- [XML sitemap](https://www.opendevutils.com/sitemap.xml): Complete list of indexable public website URLs.
